name: designvane
description: Vendor-neutral design-to-code Agent Skills: 18 skills in 3 plugins. No vendor account, no hosted MCP server, no API key.

plugins.name: designvane-design
plugins.description: Plan and specify screens before any code exists: generation briefs, prompt polish, tokens, DESIGN.md authoring, critique, and responsive layout rules.

plugins.name: designvane-build
plugins.description: Turn a settled design into production UI code: React, Vue, HTML/Tailwind, React Native, dashboards, and form patterns.

plugins.name: designvane-utilities
plugins.description: Extract, export, and harden designs: DESIGN.md extraction, static HTML export, accessibility audits, dark mode, icon systems, and motion.
